proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.spellOptionRestriction
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing grant-spell surface can override DC, area, target restriction, and duration, but it cannot narrow a granted spell to only some of its legal authored options. Wand of Fear needs that to represent the restricted Command cast honestly.

notes: No content file was authored. The item otherwise fits the existing magic-item activation + charge-pool surface, and Fear itself is representable via fixed DC 15 plus a 60-foot cone area override. The blocker is the restricted Command option set.
